```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

library(ggtext)
```

# Load data

```{r}
load("../data/figure-data/stackedbar_bewell.rda")
load("../data/figure-data/model_stats_BW.rda")
load("../data/figure-data/phylo_lacho-bewell.rda")
```

# Phylogeny

```{r}
ggplot(lachno.phylo$Segments) +
  geom_segment(aes(y = v0x, x = v0y, yend = v1x, xend = v1y)) +
  geom_point(data = lachno.phylo$Nodes, aes(x = yy, y = xx, color = Lachno), show.legend = F) +
  coord_polar() +
  # scale_color_viridis_c(option = "A", name = "log2FoldChange") +
  lims(x = c(0,1.025)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = "darkred") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave("../figures/circle_phylo_all-highlight-lach.svg")
```

# Stacked bar

```{r}
stackdatBW %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = RelAbun, fill = Phylum)) +
  facet_row(vars(timepoint), scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkslateblue", "darkgoldenrod2","cornflowerblue", "darkgreen", "darkorange4","salmon2", "cornflowerblue", "deeppink4" ,"cyan4", "salmon2"), name = "Taxa") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank()) 

ggsave(file = "../figures/BRB-Placebo_stacked_bar.png", width = 3, height = 2)

```
```{r}
stackdatBW %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_replace(timepoint,
                                 pattern = "-",
                                 replacement = " ")) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("Pre Placebo", "Post Placebo", "Pre BRB", "Post BRB"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = RelAbun, fill = Phylum)) +
  facet_row(vars(timepoint), scales = "free_x", space = "free", strip.position = "bottom") +
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 19), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 24))
ggsave(file = "../figures/Fig2B-BRB-Placebo_stacked_bar.svg", width = 10, height = 4)
```

# BRB volcano plot

```{r}
volplot.in <- mic_fc_BW %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  right_join(model_res_BW) %>%
  mutate(tlev = str_sub(term,1,1),
         tlab = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, gsub("_", " ", gsub("\\w__", "", term)), NA))

volplot.in %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = l2fc, y = -log(p.value), color = tlev, label = tlab)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_text_repel(show.legend = F) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = 2, type = "qual",
                     breaks = c("k", "p", "c", "o", "f", "g", "s"),
                     labels = c("Kingdon", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"),
                     name = "") +
  labs(x = "Log2FoldChange") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("../figures/volcano_bewell-mixed-effects.svg")
```
```{r}
volplot.in <- mic_fc_BW %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  right_join(model_res_BW) %>%
  mutate(tlev = str_sub(term,1,1),
         tlab = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, gsub("_", " ", gsub("\\w__", "", term)), NA))

volplot.in %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = l2fc, y = -log(p.value), color = tlev, label = tlab)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_text_repel(show.legend = F,nudge_x = -0.6, size = 6.75) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", type = "qual",
                     breaks = c("k", "p", "c", "o", "f", "g", "s"),
                     labels = c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"),
                     name = "Taxonomic\nRank") +
  labs(x = "Log2FoldChange") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.97, 0.05),
        legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
        legend.box.just = "right",
        legend.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.box.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),  
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5))

ggsave("../figures/volcano_bewell-mixed-effects.svg",
       height = 5,
       width = 7)

```

# BRB modelling LDA

```{r}
model_res_BW %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.11) %>%
  separate(term, into = c("TaxaLevel", "term"), sep = "__") %>%
  mutate(term = gsub("_", " ", term), 
          term = paste0("*", term, "*"),
         term = gsub("\\*Lachnospiraceae unclassified\\*", "Unclassified Lachnospiraceae", term),
         term = fct_reorder(term, estimate),
         ) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = term, fill = TaxaLevel)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Effect Size", y = "") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2", breaks = c("g", "s"), name = "Taxonomic\nRank", labels = c("Genus", "Species")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)  +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_markdown(),
        legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

ggsave("../figures/effect-size_glm-binomial.png",
       height = 3, width = 4)
ggsave("../figures/effect-size_glm-binomial.svg",
       height = 3, width = 4)
```

```{r bootstrap pval for all sig being lachno}
sample.vec <- ifelse(allspecs.remtax %in% lachno.remtax, "Lachno", "Not Lachno")

set.seed(112358)
sample.seeds <- runif(10000, 1e4, 1e5)

lachno.draws <-vector()
for(i in sample.seeds){
  set.seed((i))
  pullspecs <- sample(sample.vec, 2, replace = F)
  res <- all(pullspecs == "Lachno")
  lachno.draws <- append(lachno.draws, res)
}

sum(lachno.draws)/length(lachno.draws)
```
